revision: September 28, 2026 · Phoenix 2907571, two-seller procurement and manufacturer STEP
coordinates: X across the panel; Y above the panel underside; Z along the panel, negative toward the printer exit (rear), positive toward Q0 (front). One scene unit is one millimetre. The wiring plan projects the same X/Z positions with rear at the top. Dimensions below are X × Y × Z unless noted.

parts.name: BUD NBF-32126 · opaque hinged cover
parts.status: Manufacturer common-base STEP; opaque lid silhouette illustrative
parts.note: Selected ABS/PC NBF-32126, nominal 400 × 300 × 160 mm. The displayed CAD envelope includes projecting hinges and latches. Factory STEP linked on its page uses the NBF-32226 common base and lid outline; opaque cover is rendered gray. Preserve the hinges, latches and gasket. Custom openings remove any claim to the original ingress rating. Closed-cover operation and qualified electrical acceptance remain required. Unplug supply before opening the latches.

parts.name: Reused aluminum panel · provisional 1.90 mm
parts.status: Proposed fabrication template; stock not measured
parts.note: Proposed 260 × 340 mm aluminum panel with 10 mm corner chamfers. Thickness 1.89738 mm is provisional; measure stock and verify M5 support pattern before fabrication.

parts.name: DENT ELITEpro XC
parts.note: Long blue body uses the current 216 × 63 × 47 mm specification. The older ELOG manual gives 203 × 69 × 58 mm. Measure the photographed instrument before finalizing. Ports, feet and grip details are visual approximations; plug space is additional. Adjustable two-strap mounting uses slots 82 mm apart; reserve a 216 × 69 × 58 mm acceptance envelope. No close-fitting cradle or drilling into the logger.

parts.name: CT1 · printer hot only
parts.status: Mini HSC family matched; 50 A variant probable
parts.note: White Mini HSC 20 A and 50 A versions use the same 29.4 × 41.7 × 26.4 mm body and nominal 10 mm window (legacy drawing 10.2 mm). The partially visible DENT 50… label resembles legacy CTHSC-050-U/B; complete model digits remain covered. This establishes the family envelope, not the final ELOG scale. White is + and black is −; arrow toward printer, one hot conductor only. The illustrated body rests on the panel; it has no added mounting screw.

parts.name: Q0 · Phoenix TMC 81C 15A
parts.status: Manufacturer STEP; operating position shown, travel unverified
parts.note: Phoenix Contact TMC 81C 15A / 2907571, 15 A, 1 pole, C curve, UL489 / cUL Listed E320373, 10 kA, 277 V AC. Catalog envelope 17.6 × 116 × 75.9 mm includes 7.5 mm DIN rail. Factory STEP body/handle depth is 73.8788 mm. Terminal guards held 1.5 mm behind the 3 mm inner wall; nose and handle pass through the 18.6 × 46 mm window. Manufacturer STEP is transformed without scaling to the 1° wall frame. Verify received snap fit, operator travel, terminal access, bonds and closed-lid fit.

parts.name: JL / JN / JPE distribution
parts.note: Three WAGO 221-415 connectors in three 221-505 carriers: JL, JN and PE. Each carrier uses two M3 fasteners, lateral 20 mm spacing, at the front foot. Insert one conductor per port; strip 11 mm. A1 connects at JL downstream of Q0; acceptance of the original DENT lead termination and upstream-only protection is required before use.

parts.name: XA · internal Leviton 515CV
parts.status: Manufacturer dimensional envelope; strap installation proposed
parts.note: 515CV overall length 66.3 mm, maximum diameter 39.1 mm, axis along X. Integral enclosure and cord clamp; one continuous 14/3 branch from JL/JN/PE. Strap to panel beside the original adapter. Validate seating, support and routing at dry fit.

parts.name: CUI SMI6-9-V-P5 · existing adapter
parts.note: Reuse the original CUI 9 V / 0.667 A center-positive adapter, with its P5 plug and flat cord intact. It plugs into the internal XA cord connector; its original cable runs directly to the logger. No DC extension, coupling or wall feedthrough. Body is rotated about the plug axis to lie low on the panel. Blade geometry, mated depth and support contact remain illustrative; verify in the dry fit.

parts.name: Power glands and direct USB cable exit
parts.note: Two power glands plus one protected USB cable passage. The existing USB cable is continuous from DENT to the PC. XA and DC remain inside. PC connects only after mains is unplugged.

parts.name: DENT adapters & retained lead slack
parts.note: Three user-confirmed DENT original kit pigtails in different colors, matched to the LD-SKTSP family (254 mm nominal), feed L1 hot / L2 neutral / N neutral. Long-lead storage is an illustrative 2 m flexible length per lead at assumed 3 mm OD and 4 mm pitch. Full pigtail and CT slack is retained during assembly; displayed flexible routes do not establish exact bend radii or a cut list. PE is a separate green rated conductor. Blue in the model denotes the sensing group, not the actual jacket colors.

plan.note: Top-view shell envelope from the BUD common-base factory STEP. The aluminum panel is a custom 260 × 340 mm blank. Plan is a placement reference; use the machining files and received-part checks.

instances.label: Retained lead slack
instances.note: Scenario only: each full lead reserves 2000 mm flexible cable at assumed 3 mm OD. Three concentric helices use 4 mm radial spacing and pitch, with two shared restraints. Measure actual cable length, diameter, bend limits and support fit during dry assembly.

instances.label: USB cable bushing
instances.note: Manufacturer mounting bore 22.2 mm; passage 17.5 mm, head 24.2 mm, overall 14.3 mm. Simplified axis-aligned illustration; wall draft and actual locking features require dry fit.

installationHardware.note: Six cable supports and the dedicated panel PE bond retain shared CAD datums. Four adjustable straps: two logger straps and two internal-power straps. Stock thickness, retention and temperature require physical checks; simplified mesh details are not manufacturing proof.

cableSupports.label: Original DC cable and sleeved USB lead

usbService.note: Single existing cable, no cut/splice or intermediate USB connection. Exterior length is abbreviated. Published USB-B overmold diagonal 15.57 mm fits the nominal 17.5 mm passage before sleeving. Dry-fit the received parts, then accept insulation and retention before machining.
usbService.cableLengthBasis: Conservative 1.8 m routing allowance from the kit datasheet; the current replacement is listed as 2 m. Retain the full owned cable; actual reach is checked during assembly.

q0Mount.note: Formed bracket and rail in local wall coordinates; 1 degree case draft. 0.8 mm washer spacing between rail and bracket is provisional. Slot permits lateral adjustment; set depth from an offcut fit before folding. Combined dedicated #10 bond must contact both metal pieces by an accepted method. No ordinary mounting-screw-only bonding assumption.
